title: Choose the visual world
question: The features are fixed. Choose how the Financial Reset Planner should organize and communicate them.

options.label: The Next-Dollar Line
options.lineage: public transit control maps and station wayfinding
options.thesis: Your money moves along one clear route, with today's stop and the next milestone always visible.
options.viewport: A compact control strip shows the current stage, protected dollars, safe-to-spend amount, and the next stop on one continuous recovery line.
options.risk: The route metaphor must stay subordinate to the real numbers or it can feel too schematic.

raised.raise: The active financial stage gets one unmistakable route color while the underlying numbers remain fixed truth.
Every recommendation is paired directly with the number that proves it.
Changing one input visibly propagates through every linked plan output.
Color is confined to state and progress edges, keeping the working surface calm.
Dense information follows a strict, repeatable grid so it remains scannable.
Tabular figures align precisely and remain readable under high information density.

options.label: The Working Ledger
options.lineage: field-service work orders and ruled household ledgers
options.thesis: A trustworthy daily work sheet turns financial recovery into one practical job at a time.
options.viewport: A dated work order leads with the diagnosis, this week's assignment, and a ruled table of protected money.
options.risk: It is the most familiar and utilitarian direction, so it could feel less distinct if the typography is timid.

options.label: Recovery Course Map
options.thesis: Financial facts form the terrain; the recovery plan is a numbered course through it.
options.viewport: A map-like diagnosis plots current cash, obligations, and numbered recovery controls around the active stage.
options.case: The route logic makes the sequence unusually clear, but the outdoor visual language is less immediately familiar for money management.
options.risk: Too much map texture would compete with the numbers users came to understand.

options.label: Monochrome Proof
options.thesis: A neutral interface lets evidence sit immediately beside every recommendation.
options.viewport: The diagnosis and the calculations that prove it share a strict two-column frame.
options.case: Clear but too close to the category's default product dashboard.
options.kept: Every recommendation must show its supporting number.

options.label: Linked Recovery Sheet
options.thesis: One changed number unfolds through every connected plan output.
options.viewport: A compact diagnosis expands into linked monthly, weekly, and milestone panels.
options.case: Its linked-state logic is strong, but the aerospace material is remote from the user's daily financial life.
options.kept: Input changes must visibly propagate through the whole plan.
options.risk: Diagonal geometry can weaken form scanning and mobile usability.

options.label: Iridescent Threshold
options.thesis: A nearly neutral working surface uses a narrow spectral edge to signal changing financial state.
options.viewport: A quiet diagnosis surface gains a narrow color edge as cash flow moves from crisis toward stability.
options.case: Calm and humane, but it communicates mood more readily than the next concrete action.
options.kept: Color stays confined to progress and state edges.
options.risk: Subtle bands may not carry enough operational hierarchy alone.

options.label: Money Pages
options.thesis: Every financial task occupies a numbered page in an exact character grid.
options.viewport: A numbered index routes directly to diagnosis, weekly limits, debts, and the plan.
options.case: The structure is direct, but the retro screen language risks novelty and visual fatigue.
options.kept: Dense content uses a repeatable grid and direct numbered access.
options.risk: The rigid black screen conflicts with the requested calm, accessible tone.

options.label: Cashflow Instrument
options.thesis: Cash flow becomes a precise field of aligned values and selectable bands.
options.viewport: A high-contrast monthly cashflow field isolates the shortfall or surplus and its contributing categories.
options.case: Numerically precise but emotionally too severe for a person already under financial pressure.
options.kept: Numbers align exactly and remain legible at high density.
options.risk: The austerity can read as punishment rather than practical support.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A conventional personal-finance dashboard executed with excellent clarity.
canonCard.viewport: A top bar, summary-card grid, progress rings, and familiar sidebar navigation.
canonCard.risk: Immediately understandable but intentionally hard to distinguish from other budgeting tools.
